summary: Genenta Science S.p.A., a foreign private issuer (Italian biotech), filed a Form 6-K on June 24, 2026, reporting a Parachute Agreement (severance) and non-compete amendment with CEO Pierluigi Paracchi, entered June 19, 2026. The agreement provides a lump-sum severance of 12 months' last gross remuneration plus up to 40% target bonus upon qualifying termination. The non-compete scope was narrowed. This is a management change event tied to the CEO's potential departure, though no immediate termination is stated. Watch for any CEO succession or board governance shifts.
